PhD Student, Business Information Technology, Pamplin College of Business, Virginia Tech

The plan in one minute

Security controls work only when employees choose the protective action.

My 10-year plan studies the drivers, interventions, and consequences of employees' protective and risky security behaviors.

RQ1 · DriversWhat drives employees' protective and risky security behaviors?
RQ2 · InterventionsHow can interventions improve protective behaviors and reduce risky ones?
RQ3 · ConsequencesWhat are the consequences for the work, the data, and the firm?
